# Toolioz — Calculators, Developer Utilities & Document Tools

> Toolioz (https://toolioz.com) is a free utility website offering financial calculators, developer tools, document utilities, marriage biodata makers, and resume builders. Pages labelled local processing keep tool inputs or files in the browser. The site separately uses network services for page assets and analytics, as described in its privacy policy.

## Core Utility Hubs

- Main Web Portal: https://toolioz.com/
- Financial Calculators Hub: https://toolioz.com/finance
- Developer Utilities Hub: https://toolioz.com/devtools
- PDF Tools Suite: https://toolioz.com/pdftools
- Marriage Biodata Generator Hub: https://toolioz.com/biodata
- ATS Resume Builder: https://toolioz.com/resume-builder
- Technical How-To Guides: https://toolioz.com/how-to
- Editorial & Review Policy: https://toolioz.com/editorial-policy
- Privacy Policy: https://toolioz.com/privacy-policy

## Key Financial Calculators & Formulas

- Systematic Investment Plan (SIP) Calculator: https://toolioz.com/finance/sip-calculator
  - Formula: FV = P × [{(1 + i)^n - 1} / i] × (1 + i)
- Compound Interest Calculator: https://toolioz.com/finance/compound-interest
  - Formula: A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt)
- Mortgage & Loan Prepayment Calculator: https://toolioz.com/finance/loan-prepayment
  - Estimates tenure reduction versus EMI savings from partial principal prepayments.
- Income Tax Calculator: https://toolioz.com/finance/income-tax
  - Compares New Tax Regime (Section 115BAC) vs Old Tax Regime tax liabilities.
- Lumpsum Investment Calculator: https://toolioz.com/finance/lumpsum-calculator
- Retirement Corpus Calculator: https://toolioz.com/finance/retirement-corpus

## Privacy & Security Architecture

- Local Tool Processing: Pages identify when calculations, image processing, or PDF manipulation execute in the browser.
- Separate Network Services: Page assets, analytics, advertising, and selected online features may contact third parties. See the privacy policy for details.
